reconstruction_summary: Re-ran V1 (the agent's only positive variant) as ks_pred = (v/L)*tan(delta) using each platform's canonical wheelbase L, minus a per-segment yaw-gyro bias estimated as the mean of (ks_pred - yaw_rate_meas_rads) over straight rows (|delta|<0.01), per tools/step4_run_st_upgrade.py.
notes: Agent declares V1 favourite by elimination: V2/V3 regress past V0, V1 alone improves (REPORT 'the only positive contribution is V1's straight-rows yaw-gyro bias subtraction'). V1 was originally evaluated on Mach-E only; here it is applied to all 545 Ford segments by using each platform's own canonical wheelbase L (2.984 m Mach-E, 3.70 m F-150 Lightning) and computing the per-segment bias on straight rows of that segment.
